items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Dick Allen. What's your name? Laura Cittagone.

ctx.x: Yeah, what's your name? Clayton Dure. How do you spell it? D-U-E-R-R. And let's see, what's the day? The day is April the, you know the day? 17th. April 17th. Yeah, and where are we at 4,400? Hollygrove. Hollygrove, yeah. My name is Dick Allen. What's your name? Laura Cittagone. Okay. You want to tell us about where you were born and when? Well, I was born in New Orleans down
to French Quarter until I was about 13 years old and we moved out to this place here. And I didn't start to play fool around with a banjo until I was about 15, I guess.
